name: Halfling
text:
## Halfling Racial Traits

- **+2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, –2 Strength**: Halflings are nimble and strong-willed, but their small statures make them weaker than other races.
- **Small**: Halflings are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
- **Slow Speed**: Halflings have a base speed of 20 feet.
- **Fearless**: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by halfling luck.
- **Halfling Luck**: Halflings receive a +1 racial bonus on all saving throws.
- **Keen Senses**: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.
- **Sure-Footed**: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks.
- **Weapon Familiarity**: Halflings are proficient with slings and treat any weapon with the word “halfling” in its name as a martial weapon.
- **Languages**: Halflings begin play speaking Common and Halfling. Halflings with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Goblin.

favoredClassOptions.description: Add one extract formula from the alchemist’s list to the alchemist’s formula book. This formula must be at least one level below the highest formula level the alchemist can create.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the formula is added to the alchemist's formula book

favoredClassOptions.description: Gain 1/6 of a new arcanist exploit.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a new arcanist exploit is the player's pick

favoredClassOptions.description: Add a +1/2 bonus to trap sense or +1/3 to the bonus from the surprise accuracy rage power.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the bonus goes to trap sense or to surprise accuracy, the player's pick

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1/2 on Bluff checks to pass secret messages, +1/2 on Diplomacy checks to gather information, and +1/2 on Disguise checks to appear as an elven, half-elven, or human child.
Gain a +1/4 dodge bonus to AC while bloodraging against creatures at least one size category larger than the bloodrager.
Gain a +1 bonus to the brawler’s CMD when resisting a grapple or overrun combat maneuver.
Add +1/2 to the cavalier’s effective class level for the purposes of determining the damage he deals when making an attack of opportunity against a challenged foe.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the damage of an attack of opportunity against a challenged foe is not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Select one domain power granted at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the cleric’s Wisdom modifier. The cleric adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the domain power is the player's pick, its uses are adjusted on it

favoredClassOptions.description: Add a +1/4 luck bonus on the saving throws of the druid’s animal companion.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the animal companion's saves are on its own sheet

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1 to the fighter’s CMD when resisting a trip or grapple attempt.
Add +1/4 to the dodge bonus to AC granted by the nimble class feature (maximum +2) or +1/4 to the AC bonus gained when using the gunslinger’s dodge deed.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the bonus goes to nimble or to the gunslinger's dodge deed, the player's pick

favoredClassOptions.description: The hunter’s animal companion gains a +1/4 luck bonus on saving throws. If the hunter replaces her animal companion, the new animal companion gains this bonus.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the animal companion's saves are on its own sheet

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1/4 to the number of times per day that an inquisitor can change her most recent teamwork feat.
Add one extract formula from the investigator’s list to his formula book. This formula must be at least 1 formula level below the highest level the investigator can create.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the formula is added to the investigator's formula book

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the capacity of the kineticist’s internal buffer by 1/6 point.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the internal buffer's capacity is adjusted on the class feature

favoredClassOptions.description: The magus gains 1/6 of a new magus arcana.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a new magus arcana is the player's pick

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the bonus the medium gains from its seance boon by 1/3 point. This doesn’t increase the bonus allies gain from shared seance.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the seance boon's bonus is adjusted on the class feature

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the number of mesmerist tricks the mesmerist can use per day by 1/3.
Add +1 to the monk’s CMD when resisting a grapple and +1/2 to the number of stunning attacks he can attempt per day.
Add 1/2 point of mental focus per day.
Add +1/2 to the oracle’s level for the purpose of determining the effects of the oracle’s curse ability.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the curse's effective level is not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1/2 hit point to the paladin’s lay on hands ability (whether using it to heal or harm).
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: lay on hands' healing is rolled from the paladin's class feature

favoredClassOptions.description: The psychic treats her Charisma bonus as 1/3 point higher for the purpose of determining the number of uses or rounds per day of her discipline powers.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the discipline powers' uses are adjusted on them

favoredClassOptions.description: Add a +1/4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against the ranger’s favored enemies.

Choose a weapon from the following list: sling, dagger, or any weapon with "halfling" in its name. Add a +1/2 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls with that weapon (maximum bonus +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: critical hit confirmation rolls are not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Add 1/2 to the shaman’s effective class level for the purpose of determining her spirit animal’s natural armor adjustment, Intelligence, and special abilities.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the spirit animal's abilities are on its own sheet

favoredClassOptions.description: Choose a weapon from the following list: dagger, sling, or any weapon with the word “halfling” in its name. Add a +1/2 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls with that weapon (maximum bonus +4). This bonus doesn’t stack with those gained through Critical Focus and similar effects.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: critical hit confirmation rolls are not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Add a +1/4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against the slayer’s studied target.

Select one bloodline power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the sorcerer’s Charisma modifier. The sorcerer adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that bloodline power.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the bloodline power is the player's pick, its uses are adjusted on it

favoredClassOptions.description: Add 1/4 to the number of rounds that the spiritualist’s incorporeal phantom can be out of sight and line of effect before being sent back to the Ethereal Plane.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the phantom's rounds out of sight are not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1 skill rank to the summoner’s eidolon.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the eidolon's skill ranks are on its own sheet

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the number of times the swashbuckler can use charmed life by 1/4.
Add 1/4 to the warpriest’s effective level when determining the damage of his sacred weapon.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: sacred weapon's damage comes from the warpriest's class level

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1/4 to the witch’s caster level when determining the effects of the spells granted to her by her patron.
Add +1/2 to the wizard’s effective class level for the purposes of determining his familiar’s natural armor adjustment, Intelligence, and special abilities.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the familiar's abilities are on its own sheet
